task.title: Optimize Git-durable local mutation path
task.description: Split projection-backed reads from Git-backed canonical writes. Resolve full IDs directly, use validated SQLite tip state for mutation planning, refresh only changed or unknown heads, cache process-stable repository metadata, bound Git command cardinality, batch changed-tip reads, conditionally upsert the projection after Git CAS success, and report projection failures as nonfatal cache warnings. Preserve synchronous Git-durable CLI and HTTP success.
